cards.name: Citi Custom Cash Card

earn.note: 5% on the first $500 spent each billing cycle in the single top eligible category, then 1%. Citi's ten categories are restaurants, gas stations, grocery stores, select travel (airlines, hotels, cruise lines, travel agencies), select transit (commuter transit, rideshare, taxis, parking, tolls), sele…

An additional 4% (5% total, up to 9% when travel is also the top category) on hotels, car rentals and attractions booked through Citi Travel. Launched with an end date of June 30, 2026; Citi removed the end date and one review (updated September 2026) calls it permanent since May 18, 2025, but othe…

cards.notes: No longer open to new applicants (since 2026-05-28). The app can't tell booking types apart on the issuer's travel site, so the best of these rates applies to every booking there: Citi Travel hotels and Citi Travel car rentals and Citi Travel attractions (4x). The cap on 5% in the top eligible category resets each statement; it is counted per month here. Closed to new applications on May 28, 2026; existing cardmembers keep their terms, and some report product changes into it are still possible. Earns ThankYou points as cash back. 3% foreign transaction fee. On its own it reaches only a few transfer partners at reduced ratios; points moved to a Strata Premier, Strata Elite or legacy Prestige/Premier account transfer at full ratios, including to American AAdvantage (partner since July 27, 2025).

earn.note: 2% base plus an extra 3% on hotels, car rentals and attractions booked through Citi Travel. Launched as a limited-time offer ending December 31, 2025; Citi removed the end date, and reviews report it as permanent since May 18, 2025. Citi's page lists no end date as of 2026-11-13.

cards.notes: The app can't tell booking types apart on the issuer's travel site, so the best of these rates applies to every booking there: Citi Travel hotels and Citi Travel car rentals and Citi Travel attractions (5x). Earns ThankYou points: 1 when you buy and 1 when you pay. 3% foreign transaction fee. On its own the card reaches only a few transfer partners at reduced ratios (generally 1,000 to 700 or 1,000 to 800); points moved to a Strata Premier, Strata Elite or legacy Prestige/Premier account transfer at full ratios, including to American AAdvantage (partner since July 27, 2025).

cards.name: Citi Prestige Card

earn.note: Airlines and travel agencies. Travel agencies are modeled with cat:travel.other (merchant category 4722, which also holds 4789 transportation services). Whether bookings through Citi Travel earn 5x is not confirmed, so portal categories are not included.

cards.notes: No longer open to new applicants (since 2021-07-01). Approximated: the 3x rate on cruises counts for all other travel. Citi stopped taking applications on July 1, 2021 and product changes into the card on June 19, 2021; existing accounts remain open with the terms modeled here. A premium ThankYou card: points in a Prestige account transfer to partners at full ratios, like the Strata Premier and Strata Elite. Its premium-tier successor is the Strata Elite (launched July 27, 2025), but Prestige accounts were not converted. Reviews say the card carries no trip, baggage, rental car or shopping protections apart from cell phone protection. No foreign transaction fees.
